examples.title: San Saba River, SS01208
examples.description: A small, steep Hill Country stream: 35 cfs across a 48 ft wide channel with a 1 percent water-surface slope and a gravel bed (K about 173 ft/d). Five monitoring wells sit inside the bend. A quick tour of every stage, from reach and terrain through the groundwater model, the hyporheic zone and the site report.
examples.credit: USACE ERDC and Texas site data, 2021 field campaign

examples.title: Colorado River, CR07230
examples.description: A wide, low-gradient river reach: 341 cfs across a 230 ft wide channel with a 0.1 percent water-surface slope and a sandy bed (K about 111 ft/d). Five monitoring wells along the bank. Compare it with the San Saba example to see how width, slope and bed material change the hyporheic exchange.
examples.credit: USACE ERDC and Texas site data, 2021 field campaign
